normalized_name: sweet cajun chicken bites with rice
name: Sweet Cajun Chicken Bites with Rice
steps: Start the rice: bring 3 cups salted water to a boil, stir in the rice, cover and simmer on low 18 minutes.
Cut the chicken into 1-inch bites and pat dry. Toss with the brown sugar, Cajun seasoning, garlic powder and salt until every piece is coated.

Air-fry at 400°F in a single layer for 9 to 11 minutes, shaking the basket halfway, until the bites are caramelized and reach 165°F. Work in two batches if needed. (No air fryer: roast on a lined sheet pan at 425°F for 15 minutes.)
Steam or microwave the baby carrots until tender, about 5 minutes.
Serve the chicken bites over rice with the carrots on the side.

normalized_name: cowboy beans with beef and bacon
name: Cowboy Beans with Beef and Bacon
steps: Heat the oven to 400°F and bake the cornbread mix with the egg and milk as the box directs, about 18 minutes.
Dice the bacon and cook it in a large pot over medium heat until crisp, 5 minutes. Spoon out all but 1 tablespoon of the fat.
Add the oil, diced onion and pepper and cook 4 minutes, then add the ground beef and brown it, breaking it up, until no pink remains, 6 to 7 minutes. Drain any extra fat.
Stir in the baked beans with their sauce, ketchup, brown sugar, Worcestershire, mustard and garlic powder. Simmer 8 minutes, stirring now and then, until thick and bubbling.
Season with salt and pepper and serve in bowls with warm cornbread.

name: Hidden Veggie Cheeseburgers
steps: Heat the oven for the fries and bake them as the bag directs.
Finely grate the zucchini and squeeze it dry in a towel. Grate the carrot and mince the mushrooms and garlic very small so picky eaters won't spot them.
Mix the beef, grated vegetables, mushrooms, garlic, Parmesan, oregano and a pinch of salt with your hands just until combined. Shape 4 patties a little wider than the buns.
Cook the patties in a hot skillet or on the grill over medium-high heat 4 to 5 minutes per side until they reach 160°F. Lay a cheese slice on each for the last minute.
Build the burgers on toasted buns with lettuce, sliced tomato and avocado. Serve with the fries.

name: Tomato Basil Chicken Spaghetti
steps: Boil the spaghetti in well-salted water until al dente; save 1/2 cup of the pasta water and drain.

Season the chicken with half the basil, oregano and garlic powder plus salt and pepper. Sear in 2 tablespoons oil over medium-high heat 5 to 6 minutes per side until it reaches 165°F, then rest and slice.
In the same pan, warm the remaining oil with the rest of the herbs and garlic powder for 30 seconds. Add the halved tomatoes and cook 4 minutes until they start to burst, then stir in the balsamic.
Toss the spaghetti in the tomato sauce with a splash of pasta water, top with the sliced chicken and pass Parmesan at the table.
Steam the green beans 5 minutes and serve alongside.

name: Cheesy Beef Slider Bake
steps: Heat the oven to 350°F. Brown the beef with the diced onion, garlic powder, paprika, salt and pepper until no pink remains, 7 to 8 minutes. Drain, then stir in the ketchup and mustard.
Without pulling the rolls apart, slice the whole slab in half across. Set the bottom half in a baking dish.
Layer the cheese slices, the beef, then the shredded cheddar on the bottom half and cover with the top half.
Brush the tops with melted butter, sprinkle sesame seeds, cover with foil and bake 15 minutes; uncover and bake 5 more until golden and melty.
Cut into sliders and serve with the salad.

name: Taco Beef and Corn Quesadillas
steps: Brown the beef with the diced onion in a skillet, 7 minutes; drain the fat.
Stir in the taco seasoning, tomato paste, salsa and corn with 2 tablespoons water and simmer 3 minutes until thick.

Lay a tortilla in a lightly oiled skillet over medium heat, cover half with cheese, add a scoop of the beef and more cheese, and fold. Cook 2 to 3 minutes per side until golden and the cheese melts. Repeat.
Cut into wedges and serve with sour cream and fresh bell pepper strips.

name: One-Pot Cheesy Beef Shells
steps: Brown the beef with the diced onion in a deep skillet over medium-high heat, 7 minutes. Drain, then stir in the garlic, basil and oregano for 30 seconds.
Add the uncooked shells, 2 1/2 cups water, the diced tomatoes with their juice and the tomato paste. Bring to a boil.
Cover and simmer on low, stirring a couple of times, 12 to 14 minutes until the pasta is tender and the sauce is thick.
Stir in the Parmesan, scatter the mozzarella on top, cover 2 minutes to melt, and serve with buttered peas.

name: Smoked Sausage Queso Pasta
steps: Slice the sausage into coins and brown in a large skillet over medium-high heat 4 to 5 minutes. Add the diced onion and cook 3 minutes.
Pour in the broth, tomatoes with chilies and cream, then stir in the dry pasta. Bring to a boil.
Cover and simmer on low 12 to 14 minutes, stirring halfway, until the pasta is tender and most of the liquid is absorbed.
Off the heat, stir in the cheese until creamy. Top with sliced green onions.
Steam the broccoli and serve on the side.

name: Stuffed Pepper Rice Skillet
steps: Brown the beef in a deep skillet, 6 minutes, then drain and set aside.
Add the oil, diced onion and both peppers to the pan and cook 5 minutes until softened.
Stir in the rice, tomato paste, oregano and garlic powder for 1 minute, then add the broth, tomatoes and beef. Season with salt and pepper and bring to a boil.
Cover and simmer on low 18 to 20 minutes until the rice is tender; add a splash more broth if it looks dry.
Top with the cheese, cover until melted, and serve.

name: Creamy Chicken Corn Chowder
steps: Cube the chicken, season with salt and pepper, and brown in a little oil in a large pot over medium-high heat, 5 minutes. Set aside.
Melt the butter in the pot and cook the diced onion, pepper and celery 5 minutes; add the garlic for 30 seconds, then stir in the flour for 1 minute.
Slowly whisk in the broth and milk, then add the cubed potatoes, corn, thyme and the chicken. Simmer 15 to 18 minutes until the potatoes are tender.
Stir in the cream, season to taste and simmer 2 more minutes.
Serve with warm French bread.

name: Ranch Chicken Club Sliders
steps: Heat the oven to 350°F. Cook the bacon until crisp and crumble it. Shred or dice the chicken.
Slice the slab of rolls in half across and set the bottom in a baking dish. Spread with half the ranch.
Layer the chicken, bacon, cheese slices and the remaining ranch, then the top half of the rolls.
Brush with butter mixed with garlic salt, sprinkle with Parmesan, cover with foil and bake 15 minutes; uncover for 5 minutes to toast.
Cut into sliders and serve with baby carrots and apple slices.

name: Honey Mustard Chicken Tender Wraps
steps: Bake the chicken tenders as the bag directs until hot and crisp (an air fryer at 400°F takes about 8 minutes).
Stir the mustard, honey and yogurt into a quick honey mustard.
Warm the tortillas for a few seconds so they fold without cracking.
Spread each tortilla with honey mustard, add lettuce, diced tomato, cheese and sliced tenders, then roll up and cut in half.
Serve with baby carrots and the rest of the sauce for dipping.

name: Chicken Parm Slider Bake
steps: Bake the nuggets as the bag directs until crisp. Heat the oven to 350°F.
Halve the slab of rolls across and set the bottom in a baking dish. Layer the provolone, the nuggets, the marinara and the mozzarella, then the top half.
Brush with melted butter mixed with Italian seasoning and sprinkle with Parmesan.
Cover with foil and bake 15 minutes, then uncover 5 minutes until golden.
Cut into sliders and serve with the Caesar salad.

name: One-Pot Chicken Alfredo Penne
steps: Cut the chicken into bites and season with half the Italian seasoning, salt and pepper. Brown in the butter in a large pot over medium-high heat, 5 minutes, then add the diced onion and garlic for 2 minutes.
Add the penne, broth, cream and the rest of the seasoning. Bring to a gentle boil, stirring so the pasta doesn't stick.
Cover and simmer on low 12 to 14 minutes, stirring every few minutes, until the penne is tender. Add the broccoli for the last 5 minutes.
Stir in the Parmesan until the sauce turns silky; loosen with a splash of broth if it gets thick, then serve.

name: Easy Chicken Tortilla Soup
steps: Melt the butter in a soup pot and cook the diced onion and pepper 5 minutes. Add the garlic, cumin and chili powder for 1 minute.
Add the broth and tomatoes and bring to a simmer for 10 minutes.
Stir in the shredded chicken, rinsed black beans and corn and simmer 5 more minutes. Squeeze in the lime and season with salt.
Serve topped with crushed tortilla chips, cheese and diced avocado, so kids can add their own.

name: Chicken Spinach Ricotta Calzones
steps: Heat the oven to 425°F and line a sheet pan with parchment.
Mix the chopped chicken, chopped spinach, ricotta, mozzarella, oregano, basil and a pinch of salt.
Divide the dough into 4 and roll each into an 8-inch circle on a floured counter. Spoon filling onto one half, fold over and crimp the edges with a fork.
Beat the egg and brush the tops; cut a small slit in each. Bake 14 to 16 minutes until deep golden.
Serve with warm marinara for dipping and cucumber slices.

name: Creamy Chicken and Potato Stew
steps: Bake the biscuits as the package directs.
Cube the chicken, season with salt and pepper, and brown in the oil in a large pot, 5 minutes. Set aside.
Melt the butter and cook the sliced carrots, celery and onion 5 minutes; add the garlic, then stir in the flour for 1 minute.
Whisk in the broth and cream, add the cubed potatoes and chicken, and simmer covered 15 to 18 minutes until the potatoes are tender.
Stir in the peas for 2 minutes, season, and serve with the biscuits.

name: Lemon Ricotta Chicken Spaghetti
steps: Cook the spaghetti in salted water; save 1 cup of pasta water before draining.
Season the chicken with oregano, salt and pepper and cook in the oil over medium-high heat 5 to 6 minutes per side to 165°F. Rest, then slice.
Whisk the ricotta, Parmesan, lemon zest, 3 tablespoons lemon juice and the grated garlic with 1/2 cup hot pasta water until smooth.
Toss the hot spaghetti and chopped spinach with the lemon ricotta sauce, adding pasta water until creamy. Top with the chicken.
Serve with toasted baguette.

name: Creamy Italian Sausage Penne
steps: Cook the penne in salted water and drain.
Melt the butter in a large skillet and brown the sausage (casings removed) with the diced onion, breaking it up, 7 minutes. Add the garlic for 30 seconds.
Sprinkle in the flour, then stir in the broth, Italian seasoning and cream. Simmer 4 to 5 minutes until it thickens.
Stir in the Parmesan and spinach until wilted, then toss with the penne. Serve with the salad.

name: Sausage Tortellini Tomato Soup
steps: Brown the sausage (casings removed) with the diced onion in a soup pot, breaking it up, 7 minutes. Add the garlic for 1 minute.
Add the broth, tomatoes and Italian seasoning and simmer 10 minutes. Meanwhile bake the garlic bread.
Add the tortellini and simmer 4 to 6 minutes until tender.
Stir in the cream, season with salt and pepper and serve with the garlic bread.

normalized_name: creamy tomato soup with grilled cheese
name: Creamy Tomato Soup with Grilled Cheese
steps: Melt the butter in a pot and cook the diced onion 5 minutes; add the garlic for 1 minute.
Add the tomatoes with their juice, broth, oregano, basil, sugar, 1 teaspoon salt and some pepper. Simmer 15 minutes.
Blend until smooth (an immersion blender is easiest), then stir in the cream.
Meanwhile, make grilled cheese: butter the outside of the bread, fill with cheese and cook in a skillet over medium-low heat 3 minutes per side until golden.
Cut the sandwiches into strips for dipping and serve with the soup.

name: Oven-Crisp Chicken Tacos
steps: Heat the oven to 425°F and spray a sheet pan.
Mix the chicken with the well-drained tomatoes, green chilies, taco seasoning and lime juice.
Warm the tortillas so they bend. Fill each with chicken and a little cheese, fold, and line them up on the pan; spray the tops.
Bake 14 to 16 minutes until the shells are crisp. Warm the refried beans while they bake.
Open each taco and add lettuce. Serve with the beans.

normalized_name: black bean salsa soup with quesadilla dippers
name: Black Bean Salsa Soup with Quesadilla Dippers
steps: Warm the oil in a pot and cook the diced onion, celery and carrot 6 minutes until soft. Stir in the oregano, cumin and garlic powder for 30 seconds.
Add the drained beans, salsa and broth and simmer 10 minutes.
Blend about half the soup (or mash it with a potato masher) so it's thick but still chunky. Season with salt.
For dippers, fill tortillas with cheese, fold and cook in a dry skillet 2 minutes per side; cut into strips.
Serve the soup with a spoon of sour cream and the quesadilla dippers.

name: Cheesy Baked Ravioli
steps: Heat the oven to 400°F and grease a 9x13 dish.
Boil the ravioli 2 minutes less than the package says and drain gently.
Spread a thin layer of marinara in the dish, add half the ravioli, half the remaining sauce and half the mozzarella; repeat, then top with Parmesan.
Bake 15 to 18 minutes until bubbling and golden in spots.
Rest 5 minutes and serve with the Caesar salad.

name: Baked Ham and Swiss Sliders
steps: Heat the oven to 350°F. Halve the slab of rolls across and set the bottom in a baking dish.
Stir the mayonnaise with the mustard, paprika and onion powder and spread it on the cut sides.
Layer the ham and Swiss, add the top half, and brush with melted butter.
Cover with foil and bake 15 minutes, then uncover 5 minutes until the tops are golden and the cheese melts.
Cut apart and serve with baby carrots and grapes.

normalized_name: pork egg roll skillet with rice
name: Pork Egg Roll Skillet with Rice
steps: Cook the rice: 1 1/2 cups rice with 2 1/4 cups water, covered on low 15 minutes.
Brown the pork in a large skillet over medium-high heat, breaking it up, 6 to 7 minutes. Drain if needed and add the garlic and ginger for 30 seconds.
Add the coleslaw mix and stir-fry 4 to 5 minutes until just tender.
Stir in the soy sauce, vinegar and sesame oil and cook 1 minute.
Spoon over rice, top with green onions, and pass sweet chili sauce for anyone who wants it.

normalized_name: one pan beef burrito rice bowls
name: One-Pan Beef Burrito Rice Bowls
steps: Brown the beef with the oil and diced onion in a deep skillet, 7 minutes. Drain and add the garlic.
Stir in the rice, taco seasoning and tomato paste for 1 minute, then add the tomatoes, broth and diced pepper. Bring to a boil.
Cover and simmer on low 18 minutes until the rice is tender.
Stir in the drained beans, corn and lime juice, cover 3 minutes to heat through.
Top with cheddar and serve in bowls.

name: Weeknight Beef Stroganoff Noodles
steps: Brown the beef in a large pot, 6 minutes; drain and set aside.
Add the oil, mushrooms and onion and cook 5 minutes until browned.
Whisk in the broth, gravy mix, Worcestershire, garlic powder and cream of mushroom soup, return the beef and bring to a boil.
Stir in the noodles, cover and simmer 8 to 10 minutes, stirring often, until tender. Add a splash of water if it gets too thick.
Off the heat, stir in the sour cream. Serve with steamed green beans.

name: Pizza Zucchini Boats
steps: Heat the oven to 400°F. Halve the zucchini lengthwise and scoop out the centers with a spoon, leaving a 1/4-inch shell; chop the scooped flesh.
Brown the beef with the onion, garlic and chopped zucchini, 7 minutes. Drain, then stir in the marinara and Italian seasoning and simmer 3 minutes.
Set the boats in a baking dish, fill with the beef sauce and top with mozzarella and mini pepperoni.
Bake 15 to 18 minutes until the zucchini is tender and the cheese bubbles. Bake the garlic bread alongside.
Serve the boats with garlic bread.

normalized_name: teriyaki turkey and broccoli rice bowls
name: Teriyaki Turkey and Broccoli Rice Bowls
steps: Cook the rice. Whisk the soy sauce, 1 cup water, brown sugar, vinegar, ginger, 1 teaspoon garlic and the cornstarch into a teriyaki sauce.
Stir-fry the onion, pepper and broccoli in 1 tablespoon oil with a splash of water 4 to 5 minutes until crisp-tender; set aside.
Brown the turkey in the rest of the oil with the remaining garlic, 6 to 7 minutes.
Pour in the sauce and simmer 2 minutes until glossy and thick, then return the vegetables and carrots.
Serve over rice.

normalized_name: creamy ham potato and pea soup
name: Creamy Ham, Potato and Pea Soup
steps: Cook the diced carrots, celery and onion in the oil in a large pot 6 minutes; add the garlic for 1 minute.
Add the 1/2-inch potato cubes, ham, thyme, broth and 2 cups water. Simmer 15 minutes until the potatoes are tender.
In a small pan, melt the butter, whisk in the flour for 1 minute, then slowly whisk in the milk until thick and smooth.
Stir the white sauce into the soup with the peas and simmer 3 minutes. Season with salt and pepper.
Serve with crusty bread.

name: Pepperoni Pizza Slider Bake
steps: Heat the oven to 350°F. Halve the slab of rolls across and set the bottom in a baking dish.
Spread with pizza sauce, then layer half the mozzarella, the pepperoni and the rest of the cheese. Add the top half.
Brush with butter melted with the garlic and Italian seasoning and sprinkle with Parmesan.
Cover and bake 15 minutes; uncover 5 minutes to crisp.
Cut into sliders and serve with salad.

name: BBQ Chicken Pizza Night
steps: Heat the oven to 475°F with a sheet pan inside. Toss the chopped chicken with 2 tablespoons BBQ sauce.
Stretch the dough into a large oval on cornmeal-dusted parchment and brush the edge with oil.
Spread the remaining BBQ sauce, then the mozzarella, chicken, thinly sliced onion (skip for picky eaters) and cheddar.
Slide the parchment onto the hot pan and bake 10 to 12 minutes until the crust is browned and the cheese bubbles.
Slice and serve with salad.

name: Friday Night Pepperoni Pizza
steps: Heat the oven to 475°F with a sheet pan or pizza stone inside.
Stretch the dough into a 14-inch round on cornmeal-dusted parchment.
Spread the sauce to within an inch of the edge, cover with mozzarella and pepperoni.
Bake 10 to 12 minutes until the crust is golden and the pepperoni curls.
Serve with baby carrots and ranch.

name: Honey Garlic Chicken Lo Mein
steps: Toss the chicken cubes with the hoisin and brown in the oil in a large deep skillet, 5 to 6 minutes. Add the garlic for 30 seconds.
Add the broth, soy sauce and honey and bring to a boil. Break the spaghetti in half and stir it in.
Simmer uncovered 9 to 10 minutes, stirring often, until the noodles are tender. Add the pepper, snap peas and carrots for the last 3 minutes.
Stir the cornstarch with 2 tablespoons water, add it and cook 1 minute until the sauce clings. Serve.

normalized_name: italian sausage links with peppers and potatoes
name: Italian Sausage Links with Peppers and Potatoes
steps: Heat the oven to 425°F. Halve the potatoes and toss with half the oil, oregano, garlic powder, salt and pepper on a sheet pan. Roast 10 minutes.
Add the sliced peppers and onion tossed with the remaining oil, and nestle the sausages on top.
Roast 18 to 20 minutes more, turning the sausages once, until they reach 160°F and the potatoes are browned.
Serve as is, or tuck a sausage with peppers into a toasted roll for anyone who wants a sandwich.

name: Honey Balsamic Pork Tenderloin
steps: Boil the cubed potatoes in salted water until tender, 15 minutes, then mash with a little butter or broth.
Heat the oven to 425°F. Rub the pork with paprika, garlic powder, salt and pepper, sear in the oil in an oven-safe skillet 2 minutes per side.
Roast 15 to 18 minutes until it reaches 145°F; rest 5 minutes. (Instant Pot: seal with the broth on high pressure 5 minutes, 5-minute natural release.)
Add the broth, balsamic and honey to the pan, bring to a simmer and thicken with the cornstarch stirred into 2 teaspoons water.
Slice the pork and spoon the glaze over. Serve with the potatoes and steamed green beans.

name: Veggie Egg Fried Rice
steps: Cook the rice ahead if you don't have leftovers, spread it on a tray and chill so it fries instead of steams.
Scramble the eggs in 1 tablespoon butter in a large skillet until just set; move to a plate.
Melt the rest of the butter and cook the diced onion and carrots 4 minutes, then the garlic, ginger and peas 1 minute.
Add the cold rice, press it into the pan and let it sizzle 2 minutes before stirring; repeat twice. Add the ham if using.
Stir in the soy sauce and eggs, breaking them up, and serve hot.

name: Lemony Chicken and Orzo Soup
steps: Cook the diced onion and carrots in the oil and butter 5 minutes, add the garlic, then stir in the flour for 1 minute.
Whisk in the broth and 1 cup water, add the oregano, thyme and whole chicken breasts, and simmer 15 minutes until the chicken reaches 165°F.
Lift out the chicken, add the orzo and simmer 8 to 9 minutes until tender. Shred the chicken.
Return the chicken, add the spinach and 2 to 3 tablespoons lemon juice, and season with salt and pepper.
Serve with toasted baguette.

name: Garlic Parmesan Fettuccine Alfredo
steps: Cook the pasta in salted water, adding the broccoli for the last 3 minutes; save 1/2 cup water and drain.
Melt the butter in the pot over medium-low heat and cook the minced garlic 1 minute.
Pour in the half-and-half and bring to a gentle simmer for 3 minutes.
Take it off the heat and stir in the Parmesan a handful at a time with the garlic salt until smooth.
Toss in the pasta and broccoli, loosening with pasta water, and serve right away.

name: Creamy Broccoli Mac and Cheese
steps: Bring the broth, 1 cup water, garlic powder and a pinch of salt to a boil in a large pot. Add the macaroni.
Simmer, stirring often, 8 minutes. Add the small broccoli florets and cook 3 to 4 minutes more until the pasta is tender and most liquid is absorbed.
Lower the heat and stir in the cream, milk and butter until hot.
Stir in the cheddar a handful at a time until creamy. Season with pepper.
Serve with sliced apples.

normalized_name: fresh chicken spring rolls with peanut dip
name: Fresh Chicken Spring Rolls with Peanut Dip
steps: Cook the rice. Slice the chicken, mango, pepper and cucumbers into thin strips.
Whisk the peanut butter, 6 tablespoons warm water, vinegar, honey and soy sauce into a smooth dip.
Dip one rice paper in warm water for a few seconds until soft and lay it flat.
Add lettuce, carrot and a few strips of each filling near the bottom, fold in the sides and roll up tightly. Repeat.
Serve with the peanut dip and rice. Kids can roll their own.

name: Hearty Minestrone with Ditalini
steps: Cook the diced celery, onion and carrots in the oil 6 minutes. Add the garlic powder.
Add the drained beans, tomatoes, broth, 3 cups water, oregano and basil. Simmer 15 minutes.
Add the diced zucchini and ditalini and simmer 9 to 10 minutes until the pasta is tender.
Stir in the spinach for 2 minutes and season with salt and pepper.
Serve with crusty bread.

name: Mini Turkey Cheeseburger Sliders
steps: Bake the tater tots as the bag directs.
Mix the turkey, egg, panko, onion powder, paprika and 1/2 teaspoon salt. Shape 12 small, thin patties.
Cook in a lightly oiled skillet over medium-high heat 3 minutes per side until they reach 165°F; top each with half a cheese slice for the last minute.
Tuck into the buns with ketchup and serve with tots.

name: One-Pot Cheeseburger Macaroni
steps: Brown the beef with the diced onion in a deep skillet, 7 minutes. Drain and add the garlic.
Stir in the tomatoes, broth, Worcestershire, paprika, ketchup and macaroni. Bring to a boil.
Cover and simmer on low 10 to 12 minutes, stirring twice, until the pasta is tender.
Stir in the cream cheese until melted, then top with cheddar and cover until it melts.
Serve with steamed green beans.

name: One-Pot Chicken Parmesan Penne
steps: Season the chicken cubes with salt, pepper and half the Italian seasoning and brown in the oil in a large pot, 5 minutes. Add the garlic for 30 seconds.
Add the broth, marinara, the rest of the seasoning and the penne. Bring to a boil.
Cover and simmer on low 14 to 16 minutes, stirring every few minutes, until the penne is tender.
Top with mozzarella and Parmesan, cover until melted, and serve with salad.

name: One-Pot Turkey Spaghetti
steps: Brown the turkey with the diced onion in the oil in a wide pot, 6 to 7 minutes. Add the garlic for 30 seconds.
Pour in the marinara, broth and Italian seasoning and bring to a boil.
Break the spaghetti in half, stir it in and simmer covered 12 to 14 minutes, stirring often so it doesn't clump, until tender.
Season with salt and pepper and serve with salad.

name: Roast Beef Cheesesteak Sliders
steps: Bake the fries as directed. Heat the oven to 350°F.
Cook the diced onion and pepper in 1 tablespoon butter 5 minutes, then add the chopped roast beef, Worcestershire and half the paprika and warm through.
Halve the slab of rolls, lay 6 provolone slices on the bottom, add the beef mixture and the rest of the cheese, then the tops.
Brush with the remaining butter melted with the rest of the paprika, cover and bake 12 minutes; uncover 3 minutes.
Cut into sliders and serve with fries.

name: Honey Dijon Pistachio Salmon
steps: Cook the rice. Heat the oven to 400°F and line a sheet pan.
Lay the salmon on the pan and brush with the mustard stirred with the honey and 1 tablespoon lemon juice.
Mix the pistachios, panko, Parmesan, minced garlic and melted butter and press onto the tops. Add the asparagus around the fish with a drizzle of oil and salt.
Bake 10 to 12 minutes until the salmon flakes and the crust is golden.
Serve with rice and lemon wedges. (For a nut-free family, use extra panko instead of pistachios.)

name: Apple Butter Pork Chops
steps: Microwave or roast the sweet potatoes until tender.
Season the chops with salt and pepper and sear in the oil over medium-high heat 4 minutes per side until they reach 145°F. Rest on a plate.
In the same pan, cook the sliced apples and onion with the rosemary and cinnamon 5 minutes until soft.
Sprinkle in the flour, whisk in the broth and apple butter and simmer 2 minutes until glossy. Return the chops to warm through.
Serve with the sweet potatoes.

name: Sausage Spinach Marinara Penne
steps: Brown the sausage (casings removed) in the oil in a large pot, breaking it up, 6 to 7 minutes.
Add the penne, marinara, broth, 2 cups water, garlic powder and oregano. Bring to a boil.
Cover and simmer on low 14 to 16 minutes, stirring every few minutes, until the pasta is tender. (Pressure cooker: high pressure 5 minutes, quick release.)
Stir in the spinach until wilted and serve with Parmesan for sprinkling.

name: White Bean and Ham Soup
steps: Bake the cornbread as the box directs.
Cook the diced onion, celery and carrots in the oil 6 minutes, then the ham, garlic, rosemary and thyme 2 minutes.
Add the drained beans, broth and 2 cups water and simmer 20 minutes.
Mash about a cup of beans against the pot to thicken the soup; season with pepper.
Serve with cornbread.

name: Cheesy Rotel Chicken Spaghetti

ingredients.name: Rotel diced tomatoes with green chilies

steps: Cook the spaghetti and drain.
Season the chicken cubes with garlic powder, onion powder, salt and pepper and cook in the oil 6 to 7 minutes to 165°F.
Lower the heat and add the cubed Velveeta, Rotel with its juice and the cream of chicken soup. Stir until smooth and creamy.
Toss in the spaghetti and serve with salad. (Use mild Rotel for little ones.)

name: Sloppy Joe Slider Bake
steps: Heat the oven to 350°F. Brown the beef with the diced onion, 7 minutes, drain, and add the garlic.
Stir in the ketchup, brown sugar, Worcestershire and 1/4 cup water and simmer 5 minutes until thick.
Halve the slab of rolls, spoon the sloppy joe filling on the bottom, top with cheddar and the top half.
Brush with melted butter, cover and bake 10 minutes; uncover 3 minutes.
Serve with baby carrots.

name: Cheeseburger Smash Tacos
steps: Bake the fries. Stir the mayonnaise, ketchup, mustard and relish into burger sauce.
Divide the beef into 8 balls, season with garlic powder, onion powder, salt and pepper, and press each thin onto a tortilla.
Cook beef-side down in a hot skillet 3 to 4 minutes until browned, flip, add half a cheese slice and cook 1 to 2 minutes until the tortilla is crisp.
Fold and fill with lettuce, diced tomato and sauce. Serve with fries.

normalized_name: sheet pan chicken sausage and veggies
name: Sheet Pan Chicken Sausage and Veggies
steps: Heat the oven to 425°F. Quarter the potatoes, toss with half the oil and seasonings, and roast 10 minutes.
Add the sliced sausage, broccoli, pepper and onion tossed with the rest of the oil and seasonings.
Roast 15 to 18 minutes, stirring once, until the vegetables are browned and the sausage is hot.
Serve straight from the pan.

normalized_name: smoked sausage green beans and potatoes
name: Smoked Sausage, Green Beans and Potatoes
steps: Brown the sliced sausage in a large deep skillet 4 minutes; set aside.
Melt the butter, add the 1-inch potato cubes with the seasonings and 1 teaspoon salt, and cook 5 minutes.
Add the broth, cover and simmer 10 minutes.
Add the green beans and sausage, cover and cook 6 to 8 minutes until everything is tender and most of the broth is gone. Serve.

name: Pizza Tortilla Roll-Ups
steps: Heat the oven to 400°F and grease a baking dish.
Spread each tortilla with a thin layer of marinara, sprinkle with mozzarella and the toppings each kid likes, and roll up tightly.
Lay seam-side down in the dish, brush lightly with oil and sprinkle with the rest of the cheese.
Bake 15 to 20 minutes until golden and crisp at the edges. Serve with the remaining warm marinara and salad.

name: Taco Night Chip Bags
steps: Brown the beef with the diced onion, 7 minutes, and drain.
Stir in the taco seasoning, drained beans, salsa and 1/4 cup water and simmer 5 minutes.
Gently crush each chip bag and cut it open along the top.
Spoon the taco meat into the bags and let everyone add cheese, lettuce and sour cream. Eat right out of the bag with a fork.

name: Garlic Ricotta White Pizza
steps: Heat the oven to 475°F with a sheet pan inside.
Stir the minced garlic into the oil. Stretch the dough on cornmeal-dusted parchment and brush with the garlic oil.
Mix the ricotta, Parmesan, oregano, salt and pepper. Scatter the mozzarella over the dough, then dollop the ricotta mix on top.
Bake 10 to 12 minutes until the crust is golden and the cheese is bubbly.
Slice and serve with the Caesar salad.
